title: Elemental Gem break-gem / Feather Token readiness: design-first item-use vs spell/payload adjudication boundary
description:
RECONCILED 2026-10-18 after the architectural boundary review. This supersedes the 2026-10-17 framing where the two differ; the original text is kept verbatim in NOTES.

This is a PRE-FREEZE obligation: it blocks eshyra-o9bd.14. It is DESIGN-FIRST: the boundary decision below must be recorded before any implementation.

VERIFIED FACTS at PR #673 head 379c90f8 (still OPEN)
- The Elemental Gem's m4 entityGrant is owned and green (count 1, engine-computed endings).
- use_item break-gem is still refused on the unmodified pack, for two reasons:
  (a) magic-item:elemental-gem/m1-quantity carries F4 'spell execution and summoned entity ownership';
  (b) the operation effect 'summon-elemental' (kind castSpell, spellRef spell:conjure-elemental, concentrationRequired, 1 hour) has no exact trusted readiness clause (assertMagicItemOperationReady).
- use_item must execute for the consumption receipt to exist, and start_effect's grant authorization depends on that receipt (olc5.12.3).
- Feather Token use-token (effect token-kind-payload) is blocked by:
  - m1-quantity F9;
  - m4 F3/F2/F5, which is KEPT: the bird is a roc-sized creature grant with DM-ended endings (maximum-daily-flight-distance-reached, owner-dismisses-as-action), and an object whip grant is mixed into the same block;
  - the missing token-kind-payload clause.
- The use-anchor/bird/fan/swan-boat/tree/whip operations carry triage-stateMachine F5/F9.

THE BOUNDARY TO DEFINE, by responsibility
- Deterministic item activation, action/resource expenditure and consumption: use_item (action cost, stack-quantity spend, depletion).
- Durable receipt and grant authorization: the consumption receipt and bind credit (olc5.12.3).
- Creature identity, count, concentration and lifecycle binding: start_effect (olc5.12 / c58j: as-spell lifetime, concentration, 1-hour and 0-HP endings, successor).
- Spell effect and contextual adjudication: the DM. This covers what "as if you had cast the conjure elemental spell" means beyond the bound creature, and the gem-type to elemental mapping where it is not typed.
- Any independently selected deterministic spell procedure: NONE is selected. Do not require one.

DECIDED 2026-10-18 (user): use the EXISTING ADR 0017/0020 mechanisms.
- The compiler already supports source-backed adjudicated-by-design clauses with verbatim sourceText, as the PR #673 creature-control split showed.
- Keep deterministic item use, consumption, receipt and grant lifecycle independently owned.
- Preserve the spell:conjure-elemental relationship, and let the DM adjudicate residual spell semantics.
- Provide the EXACT trusted effect-readiness binding for the summon-elemental (castSpell) effect, without falsely claiming a deterministic spell executor.
- Preserve the gem's printed one-action casting-time override ("When you use an action to break the gem"), in place of the spell's own casting time.
- This does not justify a new representation framework. If an actual limitation of the existing schema prevents a faithful split, surface THAT SPECIFIC limitation before implementing anything new.

FEATHER TOKEN
- Separate the selected deterministic responsibilities (stack consumption; the bird creature grant, if its endings permit) from the payloads the DM adjudicates: object whip, anchor, fan, swan boat, tree, movement, geometry.
- Do not create a generic object or movement engine as a side effect.
- It is an acceptable, truthful outcome that the bird stays pending because of its DM-ended endings.

FORBIDDEN
- Bypassing readiness or manufacturing a receipt.
- Treating a modified-pack or waived-readiness test as proof that the real operation is ready.

DEPENDENCIES: depends on eshyra-c58j (it builds on the PR #673 readiness state). The readiness half of eshyra-xt6m now lives here, so xt6m depends on this bead.
acceptance_criteria:
1. Boundary decided 2026-10-18 (see DECIDED in the description): existing adjudicated-by-design clauses plus an exact trusted effect-readiness binding, with no deterministic spell executor claimed and the one-action casting-time override preserved. A specific schema limitation that prevents a faithful split is surfaced before anything new is built.
2. Truthful readiness:
   - F4 is removed from m1-quantity only if the decision shows the engine owes no spell execution.
   - break-gem becomes ready only when every residual of its castSpell effect is either executed or represented verbatim as adjudicated.
   - No readiness waiver exists in production code.
3. Real-pack execution, unmodified pack with no waiver, of each positively selected path: use_item break-gem -> consumption receipt -> start_effect bind -> identity, concentration and endings. The applicable state-integrity checks hold (the unpaid bind is refused; the second bind is refused).
4. Feather Token: the selected consumption and creature paths either become truthfully ready, or stay refused with their remaining hooks named. The whip, anchor, fan, swan-boat and tree payloads stay DM-adjudicated, with no new object or movement machinery.
5. Residual adjudication is preserved (corrected 2026-10-18): all operative source semantics outside the selected deterministic capability stay faithfully available to DM adjudication, through the existing source prose plus targeted source-grounded adjudicated clauses where necessary. Sentences are NOT duplicated one by one as separate proof obligations.
6. Not required: complete deterministic spell interpretation; a generic castSpell executor; a generic object or movement engine.
notes:
2026-10-18 RECONCILIATION (architectural boundary review; user-authorized tracking-only reconciliation, no code). Description and acceptance rewritten; still REQUIRED PRE-FREEZE (blocks eshyra-o9bd.14; user rules 2026-10-14/17; olc5 stop condition 2026-10-12 applies). Facts verified against origin/main 318a7eb6 and PR #673 head 379c90f8 (OPEN).
ORIGINAL DESCRIPTION (2026-10-17, superseded where the reconciled description differs):
After eshyra-c58j.1, use_item break-gem on the unmodified pack is still refused: (1) magic-item:elemental-gem/m1-quantity carries F4 'spell execution and summoned entity ownership' (the castSpell effect summon-elemental executes conjure elemental; the runtime binds the grant but does not execute the spell; decide own/keep); (2) operation effect 'summon-elemental' has no exact trusted readiness clause (assertMagicItemOperationReady). Feather Token use-token has the same missing-clause blocker for 'token-kind-payload' plus F9 on m1-quantity, F2/F3/F5 on m4 (object whip grant and DM-ended endings), and use-bird F5/F9 state-machine hooks. Needs a decision on how to represent a castSpell/payload effect whose lifecycle the runtime owns.
2026-10-18 addendum: PR #673 merged into main as dbbede8d at the same reviewed head 379c90f8, so every 'PR #673 head (OPEN)' fact in this description now holds on origin/main dbbede8d. The eshyra-c58j dependency is satisfied (c58j closed).
2026-10-18 USER DECISION: use the existing ADR 0017/0020 mechanisms (adjudicated-by-design clauses with verbatim sourceText, as in the PR #673 control split). Keep item use, consumption, receipt and grant lifecycle deterministic. Preserve spell:conjure-elemental, with the DM adjudicating residual spell semantics. Give an exact trusted effect-readiness binding with no claim of a spell executor, and preserve the one-action casting-time override. No new representation framework; surface any specific schema limitation first. USER CORRECTION to AC5: operative semantics outside the selected capability stay available to the DM through existing prose plus targeted adjudicated clauses; do not duplicate every sentence as a proof obligation. With these, all six reconciled beads may proceed under the normal implementation/review workflow and the convergence stop conditions.
